title: CropHistoryRecord
description: Canonical contract for historical and seasonal crop cycles per farm (Module 01 - Farm Management & Location Intelligence).

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the crop history record.

farm_id.description: Foreign key reference to Module 01 FarmProfile farm_id.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop cultivated (e.g. Wheat, Maize, Sugarcane, Cotton).

variety.description: Crop variety, cultivar, or hybrid tag.

season.description: Agro-climatic season matching Module 02 seasonal terminology.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the crop cycle.

notes.description: Agronomic notes, fertilizer usage, or disease events.
